assertion_tested: For one oblate Sersic lens at 15 arc positions and two inclinations, projected Newtonian finite-volume field agrees with analytic elliptical Sersic lensing and AQUAL deflection is stable over the specified mesh/domain/LOS variations.
non_claims: No image likelihood, covariance, full parameter-domain certification or theory validation.
Mesh convergence does not establish absolute AQUAL accuracy; the analytic absolute comparison is Newtonian only.
Outer-domain comparison at fixed nr also changes radial spacing, so its difference combines boundary and discretization effects.
All inclinations share projected q=.813; intrinsic flattening varies accordingly.
outcome: finite numerical checks passed at stated points
